top_creatures.label: Coin-hoard mimic
top_creatures.why: A treasure pile that stands up and bites reads at a glance; the metal tier is the colour and rarity signal.
top_creatures.keep: Treasure disguise, five-step metal ladder (copper to adamantite), poison touch on the top tiers.
top_creatures.change: Our own silhouette (pile with legs) and our own tier metals.
top_creatures.ref: lib/gamedata/monster.txt line 3682 (creeping mithril coins, depth 13, read in full); family lines 1588, 1992, 3063, 6326

top_creatures.label: Metal guardian statue
top_creatures.why: A statue worth killing for its loot, with heavy blows and element immunities.
top_creatures.keep: Statue body, immunities to cold, fire and poison, gold-only drop.
top_creatures.change: Our silhouette, tier names and drop table.
top_creatures.ref: lib/gamedata/monster.txt line 7105 (mithril golem, depth 30, read in full); line 5461 (iron golem, depth 22)

top_creatures.label: Elemental hound pack
top_creatures.why: A pack that glows in one element and breathes it; packs read well at 375 px as a group of small bright shapes.
top_creatures.keep: Pack summon, element colour, breath, glow radius of 2.
top_creatures.change: Pack shape, our element set and our breath look.
top_creatures.ref: lib/gamedata/monster.txt line 4609 (fire hound, depth 18, read in full, friends 100:2d7:Same, BR_FIRE); other zephyr hound entries from line 3986 (light hound) onward

top_creatures.label: Swirl vortex
top_creatures.why: A spinning mass whose element changes with depth; one body, many elements.
top_creatures.keep: Spinning body, engulf attack, element glow.
top_creatures.change: Our body shape and our element list.
top_creatures.ref: lib/gamedata/monster.txt line 5324 (fire vortex, depth 21, read in full); lines 5343, 5361, 7055, 8976, 8995, 9038, 9201, 9219, 11517, 12168

top_creatures.label: Hatchling-to-wyrm line
top_creatures.why: Four visible growth stages and a shimmering apex make a clear progression ladder.
top_creatures.keep: One body plan per element; colour equals element; multi-hued apex with shimmer.
top_creatures.change: Three stages instead of five; our stage names; our apex colour cycle and breath set.
top_creatures.ref: lib/gamedata/monster.txt line 2623 (baby blue dragon, depth 9, read in full); line 11492 (ancient multi-hued dragon, depth 53, read in full, ATTR_MULTI); great wyrms near lines 12958 to 14076

top_creatures.label: Many-eyed watcher
top_creatures.why: Each tier adds eyes and gaze effects, so the silhouette and threat both grow.
top_creatures.keep: Eye-count escalation; gaze effects as status (charge drain, exp drain, blind, confuse).
top_creatures.change: Body shape (not a sphere); our own gaze set.
top_creatures.ref: lib/gamedata/monster.txt line 9474 (beholder, depth 40, read in full); line 694 (floating eye, depth 1); line 12714 (hive-mother, depth 67)

top_creatures.label: Summon mound
top_creatures.why: A pulsing mound that does nothing but blink and summon; reads as a threat from range.
top_creatures.keep: Stationary summoner, blink, summon, late greater tier.
top_creatures.ref: lib/gamedata/monster.txt line 5104 (quylthulg, depth 20, read in full); lines 13104, 13607

top_creatures.label: Item mimic line
top_creatures.why: Each mimic disguises as an item glyph, so the player reads it as loot until it bites.
top_creatures.keep: Glyph disguise, one mimic per item class.
top_creatures.change: Our item classes and the reveal animation.

looks.label: Monster colour flicker
looks.technique: Palette cycle used only by monsters (46 entries with ATTR_FLICKER); the file says only monsters may flicker.

looks.label: Multi-hued shimmer
looks.technique: Colour rotates through an element set (24 entries with ATTR_MULTI).

looks.label: Creature glow
looks.technique: Light radius field on a monster so the glow moves with it (fire hound and fire vortex read light 2).

looks.label: Swappable tile sets
looks.technique: Five tile sets each with a mapping file, so the art layer swaps without code changes (16x16, 32x32, 64x64, 8x8, 8x16).

looks.label: Dragon colour series
looks.technique: One shape in many colours, each colour carrying an element.

looks.label: Depth-tiered ambience
looks.technique: Bells and iron doors underground at depth bands; a sound bed that changes with depth.

originals.name: Hoard mimic
originals.idea: A treasure pile that stands up in five metal tiers, with a poison touch on the top tiers and a depth gate.
originals.keep: Treasure disguise and the metal ladder.

originals.name: Metal sentinel line
originals.idea: Four statue guardians, each heavier metal, immune to two elements, dropping gold on death.
originals.keep: Element immunities and the gold drop.
originals.change: Our metals, silhouette and drop table.

originals.name: Element hound pack
originals.idea: A pack of up to twelve sharing one element, each breathing it.
originals.change: Our element set and pack shape.

originals.name: Three-stage wyrm
originals.idea: Hatchling, adult and apex in one body plan, colour equals element, apex shimmers through the element set.
originals.change: Stage count (three not five), names and breath.

originals.name: Watcher line
originals.idea: A small watcher that grows more eyes and gaze effects up to a boss.

originals.name: Summon mound
originals.idea: A stationary pulsing summoner that blinks and summons, with a late greater tier.

originals.name: Item mimic line
originals.idea: Four mimics each disguised as an item glyph, one per item class.

originals.name: Element scale set
originals.idea: Twelve colour-named armour sets, one per element or alignment.
